behavior: The signer replaces a stuck settle with a higher fee, estimates gas at the deploy block, and flags settles it cannot resolve
acceptance: A sent settle not mined after a set time is re-signed with the same nonce and a higher fee (capped), so later settles on that chain are not blocked; settle gas is estimated at the deploy receipt block where the node supports it (Arbitrum L1 data gas covered); an intent that cannot be resolved (no receipt, receiver settled, our nonce used at finalized) gets a stored reason, slows its retries and shows in an ops query; Anvil tests cover a stuck low-fee settle being replaced and booked once
notes: 2026-10-10 review pass by reviewer: PASS. settlement tests -race x3 no flakes. Saved before send for settle and every replacement; replacement guarded by status='sent' AND tx_hash=old plus the advisory lock; confirm books once (FOR UPDATE, unique index) with the mined receipt's hash; a new nonce is signed only via retry when the nonce is spent; replaced_hashes cleared only then. Same nonce, gas, calldata; fee bump max(current, ceil(9x/8)) in big.Int. Booking still waits for finality and Settled at finalized (D-45). Ops SQL planned against migrated schema; 00012 down reverses up. Fixed after review: a revert at the deploy block no longer falls back to latest; stall wait documented as 2 min doubling; a describing comment removed. Re-verified 9 checks.

proof.1: backend: TestStuckSettleIsReplacedWithAHigherFee (a settle sent, then dropped when the base fee rose above its fee cap and refused when resent, is re-signed with the same nonce and at least 1/8 more tip and fee cap; it and a later settle on the chain both mine; booked once with the replacement hash; fails on the old code with 'max fee per gas less than block base fee' and the later deploy blocked), TestReplacedSettleThatMinesIsBookedOnce (the replaced first version mines instead of the replacement: booked once with that hash), TestStuckSettleOverTheMaxFeeIsSentAgainAsItIs (a bump over MaxFeeFactor x the current fee cap is not signed; the saved bytes are resent), TestSettleGasIsEstimatedAtTheDeployBlock (settle gas comes from eth_estimateGas at the deploy receipt block, e.g. an Arbitrum-size 400k estimate is used over the floor; a node refusing the block falls back to latest with the F105 floor), TestStaleNotSettledReadKeepsOurSuccessfulSettle (no receipt, receiver settled and our nonce used at finalized: intent stays sent with a stored reason, a slower retry, and is listed by the ops query in docs/backend/architecture.md#unresolved-settles); all on real Anvil and Postgres
